en.name: Fresh chutney
en.summary: Fresh chutney is blended raw herbs, chilli and often raw onion, garlic or grated coconut, with none of the sugar, acid or cooking that preserves a jarred one. It is a refrigerator food with about 3–5 days in it. Herb versions freeze usefully; coconut ones do not.
en.pantry: Fresh chutney should never sit at room temperature. It is a raw, high-moisture food with nothing in it doing any preserving, so the ordinary rule applies: back in the fridge within two hours, or one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). That clock includes the time it spends on the table at a meal, so serve it in a small bowl and keep the rest cold.
en.fridge: Refrigerate it the moment it is made, at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in a container filled as full as possible so there is little air above it — about 3–5 days. That figure is shortened from the fresh salsa line because a chutney is built on soft herb leaves and grated coconut rather than on acidic tomato and lime; no agency publishes a figure for fresh chutney. Coconut chutney is the short one: fresh grated coconut sours quickly even cold, and any chutney that has turned fizzy or smells yeasty is fermenting. Extra lime juice both keeps the green colour and helps it last.
en.freezer: Herb chutneys freeze well in ice-cube trays and thaw in minutes, which is the practical way to keep a big batch. Coconut chutney does not freeze — it separates into oil and grit. No source gives a freezer limit for fresh chutney, so treat a few months as the ceiling and label the bag with the date you made it. Freeze at −18 °C (0 °F), then bag the cubes so you can take out one at a time.
en.thawing: Thaw chutney cubes in the fridge or at the table in the bowl they will be served from; they take only minutes. Do not leave a large batch thawing on the counter.
spoilage: Fizzing, bubbling or a lid that has pushed up — it is fermenting
A yeasty, alcoholic or sour smell rather than a bright herbal one
A dull brown or grey colour with liquid separating out, especially in coconut versions
tips: Make it in the amount you will eat over the next few days.
Add extra lime or lemon juice — it holds the colour and buys a little time.
Fill the container to the top to cut down on air.
Freeze herb chutney in ice-cube trays; skip freezing coconut chutney altogether.

faq.q: How long does fresh chutney last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 3–5 days at 4 °C or below in a full, sealed container. Coconut versions are at the short end of that.

faq.q: Can you freeze coriander or mint chutney?
faq.a: Yes — ice-cube trays work very well and the cubes thaw in minutes. No agency gives a limit, so treat a few months as the ceiling.

faq.q: Why did my chutney go fizzy?
faq.a: It is fermenting. A raw, low-acid, high-moisture blend will do that once yeasts take hold. Discard it.

faq.q: Why does coconut chutney spoil so fast?
faq.a: Fresh grated coconut sours quickly even under refrigeration, and there is no acid or sugar in the mix to slow it down.

zh.name: 新鮮香草酸辣醬
zh.summary: 新鮮 chutney 是把生香草、生辣椒，常常還有生洋蔥、生蒜或椰子絲直接打成的醬，沒有瓶裝款那些糖、酸和熬煮在保存它。它是冷藏食品，大約有 3～5 天的壽命。香草款很適合冷凍，椰子款則不行。
zh.pantry: 新鮮 chutney 絕對不能放在室溫。它是含水量高的生食，裡面沒有任何東西在做保存的工作，所以一般規則照舊：兩小時內回冰箱，廚房超過 32 °C 時縮短為一小時。這個時鐘也包含它在餐桌上的時間，所以請只裝一小碗端出來，其餘冰著。
zh.fridge: 做好就立刻冷藏，放 4 °C 以下，容器盡量裝滿以減少上方空氣，大約 3～5 天。這個數字是從新鮮莎莎醬的資料往下縮短的，因為 chutney 的基礎是柔軟的香草葉和椰子絲，而不是帶酸的番茄和萊姆；沒有機構為新鮮 chutney 公布過數字。椰子款是最短的：新鮮椰子絲即使冷藏也很快變酸，而任何開始冒泡或有酵母味的 chutney 都代表正在發酵。多擠一點萊姆汁，既能保住綠色，也能讓它撐久一點。
zh.freezer: 香草類的 chutney 很適合用製冰盒冷凍，幾分鐘就能解凍，這是保存一大批最實際的方法。椰子款不能冷凍——會分離成油和粗粒。沒有來源給出冷凍期限，所以請把「數個月」當成天花板，並在袋子上寫製作日期。放 −18 °C 凍硬後裝袋，要用時一次取一塊。
zh.thawing: Chutney 冰塊可以放冷藏解凍，或直接放進要上桌的碗裡，幾分鐘就化了。不要把一大批放在室溫慢慢退冰。
spoilage: 冒泡、起氣或蓋子被頂起來——那是在發酵
聞起來有酵母味、酒味或酸味，而不是清爽的香草味
顏色變成暗褐或發灰並且出水，椰子款尤其明顯
tips: 做接下來幾天吃得完的量就好。
多加萊姆或檸檬汁——能保色，也能多爭取一點時間。
容器裝滿到頂，減少空氣。
香草款用製冰盒冷凍；椰子款就別冷凍了。

faq.q: 新鮮 chutney 放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封裝滿、放 4 °C 以下大約 3～5 天。椰子款屬於這個範圍裡最短的。

faq.q: 香菜或薄荷 chutney 可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，製冰盒效果很好，冰塊幾分鐘就化開。沒有機構給期限，請把數個月當成上限。

faq.q: 我的 chutney 為什麼會冒泡？
faq.a: 它在發酵。生的、低酸、含水量高的醬被酵母菌佔領後就會這樣，請丟掉。

faq.q: 椰子 chutney 為什麼壞得特別快？
faq.a: 新鮮椰子絲即使冷藏也很快變酸，而且醬裡沒有酸或糖可以拖慢它。
